name: foxmath
summary: Minimalist CLI & library for number theory and cryptography: Lucas-Lehmer Mersenne primality test & perfect numbers, Fermat's difference of squares, RSA & Diffie-Hellman cryptosystems, BSGS discrete log solver, arithmetic functions (μ, σ, τ), Jacobi symbol & Solovay–Strassen test, Pollard's ρ factorization, totient & Carmichael functions, Tonelli-Shanks roots, interactive REPL, Weierstrass elliptic curves, Chinese Remainder Theorem, and continued fractions.
